result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.is_attracting_component()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Check if a directed graph is a single attracting component. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L56949-L56988){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.is_attracting_component() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Is attracting component](/assets/graphs/is-attracting-component.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Left: a directed cycle A to B to C to A; a walk can go anywhere and never leave, so the whole graph is one attracting component and is_attracting_component() returns True. Right: the same triangle with the edge between C and A reversed to point from A to C (shown in the accent color); walks now end at C, the only attracting component, which leaves out A and B, so is_attracting_component() returns False." width="100%"} True when the whole graph is one attracting component: strongly connected, so a walk can get from anywhere to anywhere and never leave. For a Markov chain this is irreducibility. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `True` if the graph has exactly one attracting component and it contains every node. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is undirected. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Uses `attracting_components()`; matches NetworkX's `is_attracting_component`. ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#58a0ae57 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec cycle = ec.Graph(directed=True).add_nodes(["A", "B", "C"]) cycle.add_edges([("A", "B"), ("B", "C"), ("C", "A")]) cycle.is_attracting_component() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` True ``` ::: :::
